module origen_086361(
    input [1:0] Z,
    input rst,
    output reg [3:0] Q1,
    output reg tc1
);
    always @(posedge Z[1] or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            Q1 <= 4'b0000;
            tc1 <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (Q1 == 4'b1001) begin
                Q1 <= 4'b0000;
                tc1 <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                Q1 <= Q1 + 1;
                tc1 <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
